_factory.name: Vestas blade plant, Goleniów (LM Wind Power until September 2025)
facts: The V172 blades are built here: LM Wind Power built them for Vestas under contract; Vestas signed the takeover on 15 May 2025 and runs the plant since 5 September 2025, saying it will continue to deliver V172-7.2 MW blades.
Opened 2009, extended 2017, about 400 employees; 25 km north-east of Szczecin, beside the S3 expressway.
The convoy leaves the blade yard on Prosta and Granitowa and joins the S3 at the Goleniów junction — the first survey point.

_sources.t: Vestas: Vestas officially takes over Goleniów onshore blade factory (September 2025)
GE Vernova / LM Wind Power: Vestas and LM Wind Power sign deal for blades factory in Poland (May 2025)

muenster-lech-lozienica.note: The convoy leaves the blade plant on the estate road, turns left at km 2.62 and beside the railway at Łozienica, then takes the S3 loop ramp (radius 53 m, 116°). Wheels stay on asphalt. Passage depends on clearing the 30 m blade swing, the adjacent slip road and the railway-junction lamps and fences.
measures: On the S3 loop ramp, close the parallel slip road west of the loop (around 53.5345,14.8090) and the nearside lane of the S3 at the merge (around 53.5337,14.8100) while the blade swings through.

At the junction beside the railway (around 53.5303,14.8102), check that the blade tip swing stays outside the railway boundary and away from its overhead-line masts; agree it with the rail operator if it does not.

At the km 2.62 corner, walk the woodland edge south-west of the junction (around 53.5286,14.8032) for branches in the tip swing; the inside corner is open grass and only needs to be clear of parked vehicles and stored material.

muenster-lech-finowfurt.note: Straight southbound A 11 under the Marienwerderstraße bridge just north of the Finowfurt junction and, since version 5, on to km 125.97 under the Fichtenweg bridge south of the junction. Wheels and blade stay on the road. The Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) puts the top of the Marienwerderstraße deck 5.70 m above the A 11, so the low earlier estimate was no artefact: the convoy's 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 0.90 m deep, a slim slab. It puts the Fichtenweg deck top (km 125.82) 5.99 m above the road, 5.95 m at its lower edge, so 4.8 m is clear there only if that deck is less than 1.15 m deep; a March 2025 street photo (Panoramax) shows Fichtenweg as an old beam bridge with a central pier and no height-limit sign on its face. Passage depends on the registered clear heights of both bridges over the lane used being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Marienwerderstraße overpass at 52.851926, 13.667833 from Autobahn GmbH Nordost's structure records, measured over the southbound lane the convoy will use, before the permit is issued.
If the registered height is below 4.8 m, plan the detour before reaching this point: the Finowfurt exit ramps leave south of the bridge, so a southbound convoy cannot get round it at this junction.
Get the registered clear height of the Fichtenweg overpass at 52.847199, 13.665585 from Autobahn GmbH Nordost for the same lane.

Both southbound Finowfurt ramps lie between the two bridges: a convoy too high for Fichtenweg can leave at the Finowfurt exit but cannot rejoin the A 11 before Fichtenweg, so any detour from there runs on local roads to a later junction (not assessed here).

muenster-lech-briese.note: Straight stretch of rebuilt six-lane A 10 under a path bridge (5.3 m, clears) and the four-track Nordbahn and S-Bahn bridges. Turning and width are fine. The Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) puts the tops of the railway decks 6.09–6.14 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the decks, ballast included, are less than 1.29 m deep; rail decks are often deeper. Passage depends on the registered clear height of the railway bridges, and of the sign gantry east of them, being at least 4.8 m. A 2026 street photo (Panoramax) shows the railway bridge with a deep deck under the overhead wires and no height-limit sign on its face.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Nordbahn/S1 railway bridge (52.69939, 13.28424) from Autobahn GmbH Nordost / DB InfraGO and put it in the permit; if any lane is lower than 4.8 m, name the lane the convoy must use under the bridge.
Check the clear height of the overhead sign gantry on the westbound carriageway about 35 m east of the railway bridge (approx. 52.69934, 13.28478); the survey does not list it.

muenster-lech-grossziethen.note: Straight A 10 northern Berlin ring with no geometric constraint. In the Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) the top of the forest-road overpass at 52.6991, 13.0105 is 5.54 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if its deck is less than 0.74 m deep. Passage depends on its registered clear height over the convoy's lane being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the forest-road overpass at 52.699062, 13.010454 from the Autobahn GmbH (Nordost) structure records. Measure it on site for each lane, because crossfall makes one lane lower than the other, and drive in the lane with the most clearance.

If the confirmed clearance is below 4.8 m, plan a bypass in advance. That means leaving the A 10 at the junction before the bridge and rejoining after it, or using a route around this ring section, because a motorway carriageway offers no local alternative line.
Also check the clear height of the sign gantry at the northern end of the passage (near km 196.34), which the survey does not list.

muenster-lech-paaren-im-glien.note: Straight four-lane A 10 section with no swept-path problems. The only issue is the secondary-road bridge over the motorway at 52.6494, 12.9992: in the Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) its deck top is 5.64 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 0.84 m deep. The registered clear height must be at least 4.8 m before the convoy passes. A 2025 street photo (Panoramax) shows an old beam bridge with a central pier and no height-limit sign on its face.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the overpass at 52.64935, 12.999165 from Autobahn GmbH Nordost / the bridge register in the permit, and survey it on site if the register gives under 4.9 m.
If the registered clearance is marginal, find out which lane has the most clearance under the deck and drive that lane at walking pace with a height pole vehicle ahead.

muenster-lech-glien.note: Straight six-lane A 10 with no turning or swing problems. The one open point is the Brieselanger Straße overpass (52.6184, 12.9774): in the Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) its deck top is 5.70 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 0.90 m deep. Its registered clear height must be at least 4.8 m before the convoy goes. A 2025 street photo (Panoramax) shows an old beam bridge with a central pier and no height-limit sign on its face.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Brieselanger Straße overpass (52.618385, 12.977358) from Autobahn GmbH, Niederlassung Nordost, and find out which lane has the most clearance under the deck. Use that lane, closing the neighbouring lane if needed.

If the registered height is under 4.8 m, choose another route for this stretch of the Berliner Ring. The junction's loop ramps (radius about 50 m) are too tight for an 84 m blade, so going off and back on at this junction is not an option.

muenster-lech-zeestow.note: Straight six-lane A 10 at Zeestow and, since version 5, on to km 213.44 through the Berlin-Spandau junction (26). Steering and blade swing are no problem. Passage depends on the Brieselanger Straße and Kuhdammweg overpasses: in the Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) their deck tops are 5.73 m and 5.58 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the decks are less than 0.93 m and 0.78 m deep. Their registered clear heights must confirm at least 4.8 m over the convoy's lane. 2025 street photos (Panoramax) show both as old beam bridges with a central pier and no height-limit sign on their faces. The extension adds the two parallel B 5 bridges at the Berlin-Spandau junction (km 213.29): the laser point cloud puts their deck tops 6.75–7.0 m and 6.45–6.85 m above the road across the convoy's band (lowest point 6.41 m), so 4.8 m is clear if the lower deck is less than 1.61 m deep there, likely but not confirmed.
measures: Get the registered clear heights of the Kuhdammweg bridge (52.561939, 12.967764) and the Brieselanger Straße bridge (52.573389, 12.972368) from Autobahn GmbH Nordost in the VEMAGS permit, and confirm both are at least 4.8 m over the lane the convoy uses.

If the Brieselanger Straße bridge is under 4.8 m, check with a swept-path run whether the convoy can avoid it at the Brieselang junction: leave by the southbound off-ramp, cross Brieselanger Straße straight onto the on-ramp under police control, then rejoin the motorway.

Get the registered clear heights of the two B 5 bridges over the A 10 at the Berlin-Spandau junction (52.555693, 12.964913 and 52.555801, 12.964957) from Autobahn GmbH Nordost; with about 1.6 m left for the lower deck this is a confirmation, not an expected problem.

muenster-lech-kartzow.note: Straight A 10 at Kartzow; bends are no problem. The only question is the farm-road bridge 'Zu den Erdlöchern' (km 220.77): in the Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) its deck top is 5.62 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 0.82 m deep. The registered clear height over the lane driven must be at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the overbridge 'Zu den Erdlöchern' over the A 10 (52.48934, 12.96329) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Nordost. Measure it on site, lane by lane, under both deck edges of the southwest-bound carriageway the convoy uses.

If the clearance over the planned lane is under 4.8 m, check whether another lane or the hard shoulder has more. If none does, plan a lower front unit or root carrier, or a detour around the bridge, before the permit is applied for.

muenster-lech-industriegebiet.note: Straight A 9 (R 850 m) through the 309 m covered section "Einhausung Bayreuth" (km 554.353–554.662) under the Bayreuth–Warmensteinach railway, a 110 kV line and a cross street, then under its green and PV roof. Bends and width are no problem. The road falls about 1.4 % through it (355.2 m above sea level at the north portal, 350.8 m at the south portal, from the 1 m laser terrain). Its clear height is estimated at 4.68 m ± 0.6 from the lid, which stands 6.2–6.5 m above the road, minus 1.5 m of slab and cover; the laser point cloud (Feb 2023) cannot see inside. Passage depends on the covered section's registered clear height, including ceiling fittings, being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the covered section (portals at about 49.9563,11.6068 and 49.9536,11.6075) from Autobahn GmbH Nordbayern, including anything hanging from the ceiling (lights, jet fans, signs, cameras), and book the passage through the tunnel control centre.

If the covered section is below 4.8 m, plan a bypass: leave at the exit ramp north of the portal, cross the junction and the level crossing at grade with police, and rejoin the A 9 south of the PV roof.
Check the bridge construction site at 49.9593,11.6059 for falsework or protective scaffolding over the carriageway on the transport date, because it can cut the measured 5.2-6.3 m clearance.
muenster-lech-industriegebiet.capnote: The clear height inside the 309 m covered section is estimated from its lid (4.68 m ± 0.6), not measured: the laser point cloud cannot see under the lid, so the registered height still needs confirming.

muenster-lech-steinberg.note: Straight six-lane A 9 under the Renzenhofer Straße overbridge; the convoy stays on the carriageway with no overswing. In the laser point cloud (Jan 2025) the top of the Renzenhofer Straße deck is 6.08 m above the A 9, so 4.8 m is clear if the deck is less than 1.28 m deep, which is usual for an overbridge of this span but not guaranteed. Passage depends on the registered clear height in the Autobahn GmbH bridge records being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Renzenhofer Straße overbridge (49.4738, 11.2597) for the southbound lanes from Autobahn GmbH Nordbayern. If it is below 4.8 m, use the lane with the highest soffit, or plan a detour at the nearest junction before the bridge after checking its ramps against the convoy's swept path (the cloverleaf loops at Kreuz Nürnberg 2 km south are too tight).
Also check the clear height of the overhead sign structure about 50 m north of the bridge over the southbound carriageway (approx. 49.4744, 11.2605). The clear-height list does not include it.
muenster-lech-steinberg.capnote: Laser point cloud (Jan 2025): deck top 6.08 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear if the deck is less than 1.28 m deep; verify the registered clear height.

muenster-lech-roethenbachtal.note: Straight A9 run under the A 3 bridge at the Nürnberg interchange. Curves and road width are no problem. In the laser point cloud (Dec 2024) the tops of the A 3 decks are 5.94–6.11 m above the A 9, so the convoy's 4.8 m is clear only if the decks are less than 1.14 m deep at the lowest edge; a deep girder could still be too low. Only the bridge's registered clear height, ideally for each lane, decides whether this passage works.
measures: Get the registered clear height of both decks of the A 3 bridge over the A9 at 49.45866, 11.24378 for every southbound lane, and route the convoy in the lane with the most clearance.
If any lane is below 4.8 m, plan a detour off the A9 before the interchange: the cloverleaf loop ramps (radius about 50 m) cannot carry a 95 m convoy around the bridge.
muenster-lech-roethenbachtal.capnote: Laser point cloud (Dec 2024): deck tops 5.94–6.11 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the decks are less than 1.14–1.31 m deep. Registered height still to be checked.

muenster-lech-pichl.note: Near Pichl the blade crosses the hatched gore where the slip road joins the B 16 and overswings onto grass. Passage depends on the bridge carrying the Pichl road over the B 16 giving 4.8 m clear; in the laser point cloud (Dec 2022) the top of the Mitterstraße deck is 5.72 m above the B 16, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 0.92 m deep. Confirm the registered height. The second flagged bridge is a mapping error: the photo shows no structure. Extended to start at km 715.67, the passage now covers the exit from the A 9 southbound at the Manching junction (63) onto the ramp to the B 16, a right-hand curve of radius about 80–110 m. With the front axle at km 715.92–716.07 (48.711757, 11.483897 to 48.710884, 11.482498), the scan finds the blade up to 7.28 m beyond the traced carriageway edge, deepest at km 716.015; against the traced paved surface it is up to 5.7 m over the whole passage. On the inside (west) verge, its underside passes at guide-post height over 11 guide posts between 48.711941, 11.483814 and 48.711102, 11.483031, from 0.42 m clear to 0.02 m too low. The posts are not mapped: the model places them along the traced edge at the standard spacing for the curve (10–20 m), and real guide posts line ramp curves like this one at similar spacing. A simple swept-path check (root on the front unit, rear support 50 m behind on the path) puts the inside cut over those posts. It puts the farthest reach at the swinging tail on the outside (east): over the A 9 hard shoulder at the diverge, then over the grass between the ramp and the A 9, close to the shrub row at about 48.711500–48.712000, 11.484000–11.484200. The MEWA car park on the inside is about 14 m from the ramp edge, outside the swing. The aerial photo is from 23 May 2026.
measures: Measure the clear height under the Pichl road bridge at 48.712699, 11.474168 (laser, both lanes) or get it from the Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt bridge records before the first run; if it is under 4.8 m, plan a detour leaving the B 16 at the ramps east of the bridge.
Remove the delineator posts and any sign at the nose of the hatched gore at 48.7107, 11.4822, and drive across the hatched area at walking pace.

Check the tree row on the south verge of the B 16 between 48.7104, 11.4800 and 48.7106, 11.4825 for branches over the road in the blade swing: the edge trace there follows the tree crowns, so the computed overswing on that side is not reliable.

Take down the 11 guide posts on the inside verge of the Manching exit ramp, between 48.711941, 11.483814 and 48.711102, 11.483031, with Autobahn GmbH Südbayern, and put them back after the convoy. Check that nothing else on that verge stands higher than about 1 m.
Close the right-hand lane and the hard shoulder of the A 9 southbound at the Manching exit (around 48.711700, 11.484000) while the convoy turns off, because the blade's tail sweeps across them.
On the pre-run, cut back any shrub over about 3 m high in the row between the ramp and the A 9 (about 48.711500–48.712000, 11.484000–11.484200) that lies within 10 m of the ramp's outer edge.

muenster-lech-seehof.note: Four-lane B 16 through the Seehof junction near Manching. Gentle curves: wheels stay on the road and the blade barely swings past the edge. Passage depends on clear height under the two junction overpasses. Both look like standard modern bridges, but normal design does not guarantee the 4.8 m needed. Confirm the official heights. In the laser point cloud (Dec 2022) the Oberstimmer Straße deck top is 7.91 m above the road, clear for any normal deck, and the Im Weiherfeld deck top 6.46 m, clear if that deck is less than 1.66 m deep. Extended to km 721.97, the passage now includes the two-lane B 16 (motorroad) west of the junction, along the lake. At km 721.648–721.659 (48.703065, 11.414082) the blade swings up to 0.35 m beyond the north edge, over grass; at km 721.60 and 721.71 it reaches 0.31 m and 0.34 m. The scan finds no tree crowns in the swing. It also places a speed-limit sign (274, 2.60 m high; blade underside 1.46 m) at 48.703078, 11.413853, at the 100/80 km/h change at km 721.664, and an end-of-limit sign (278, 2.75 m; underside 1.93 m) at 48.703042, 11.411864 on the north verge. Neither sign is a mapped object: the scan puts such signs where the mapped speed limit changes, so whether and exactly where they stand is not confirmed, and the 20 cm photo cannot show them.
measures: Get the official clear height of both Seehof overpasses (48.704847, 11.418822 and 48.706922, 11.423206) from the bridge records of Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt. Measure the lowest point over every lane in the convoy's direction.

If either bridge is below 4.8 m, plan a lower root-adapter or front-unit setup before the trip. There is no level detour: the NE bridge also spans the railway, and the junction ramps lead back onto the road that crosses the SW bridge.
Keep the convoy in the lane centred under the highest part of each deck, and pass under the bridges at walking pace with a spotter watching the root adapter's top edge.

On the pre-run, find the speed-limit signs on the north verge of the westbound B 16 between 48.703100, 11.414700 and 48.703000, 11.411500. Have the Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt take down any plate within about 3.5 m of the convoy's centre line and higher than 1.4 m, or pass it on the centre line with oncoming traffic held.
No action for the overswing of up to 0.35 m at km 721.60–721.71: it is over the grass verge.

muenster-lech-obermuehle.note: Gentle 1 km curve on the two-lane B 16 (radius about 580 m) with the Obermühle junction in the middle. The curve causes no trouble. The wheels stay in the own lane, but the 4.2 m blade root reaches up to 0.8 m over the centre line, so oncoming traffic needs a rolling block and the junction must be held by escort. Extended to km 728.51–731.66, the passage now includes three overpasses, all confirmed on the aerial photo of 23 May 2026. The first is the ND 18 bridge with a footpath at 48.711480, 11.322925 (km 728.76). In the laser point cloud (December 2022) its deck top is 6.21 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.41 m deep. The second is an unclassified road bridge at 48.711850, 11.316712 (km 729.22), with a deck top of 6.02 m, clear only if the deck is less than 1.22 m deep. The third is a two-lane link-road bridge at 48.716935, 11.287064 (km 731.52), with a deck top of 6.17 m, clear only if the deck is less than 1.37 m deep (estimate 4.87 ± 0.45 m). None of the three can be decided from open data.
measures: Have escort vehicles hold both arms of the Obermühle junction (about 48.7159, 11.3051) while the convoy and its 33 m blade overhang pass, because the tip crosses the junction mouths late.
Hold oncoming traffic over the whole 1 km as one rolling block between the field section in the west and the end of the forest in the east. There is no place to pull in partway through.

Before the permit, get the registered clear heights of the three overpasses (48.711480, 11.322925; 48.711850, 11.316712; 48.716935, 11.287064) from the Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt bridge records, or measure them on site. Any of them below 4.8 m blocks the B 16 for the planned setup.
muenster-lech-obermuehle.capnote: The 0.16 m wheel clearance and keep-right figures come from trace errors along shadows and verges; the real need is routine oncoming-lane use with an escort

muenster-lech-zell.note: B 16 bypass north of Zell (Neuburg a. d. Donau): gentle bends, wheels stay on the road, small blade overswing. Passage is decided by the road bridge over the B 16 at 48.7162, 11.2389. Such bridges are usually built to 4.70 m and the convoy needs 4.8 m. Get the measured height before approval. In the laser point cloud (Dec 2022) the top of the Alarmstraße deck is 6.24 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear if the deck is less than 1.44 m deep. Extended to km 736.61, the passage now includes three speed-limit signs (274, 2.60–2.75 m high) that the scan places on the north verge, where the blade's underside is 1.93 m: at 48.716992, 11.228385 (km 735.92), 48.718679, 11.222970 (km 736.36) and 48.719063, 11.221757 (km 736.46). They sit at the mapped speed-limit changes (100/80, 100/70 and 70/80 km/h). None of them is a mapped object, so whether and exactly where they stand is not confirmed, and the 20 cm photo cannot show them.
measures: Get the measured clear height of the overpass at 48.716188, 11.238934 from the Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt (bridge book). If it is under 4.8 m, the root adapter must be lowered or the route changed: the interchange ramps are too tight for a 95 m convoy to bypass the bridge.
Measure the clear height on site across the whole 4.2 m width of the root frame, including the oncoming lane the convoy will use, because clear height under the deck can vary across its width.
Keep the at-grade junction with traffic islands at about 48.7153, 11.2491 clear of oncoming and turning traffic while the convoy crosses it on the oncoming lane.

On the pre-run, locate the speed-limit signs on the north verge of the westbound B 16 between 48.716950, 11.228500 and 48.719100, 11.221600. Have the Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt take down any plate within about 3.5 m of the convoy's centre line, or pass it on the centre line with oncoming traffic held.

muenster-lech-fleischnershausen.note: At the B 16 roundabout at Fleischnershausen the convoy goes round the wrong way, north of the island, with every arm closed. Passage depends on the blade clearing the island's northern half, removing a give-way sign on the east splitter island, and keeping the 28 m overswing NW and NE free of trees. Extended to km 740.42, the passage now covers the B 16 west of the roundabout towards Neuburg. At km 738.107–738.125 (48.721509, 11.201071) the blade swings up to 0.84 m beyond the north edge. Two trees in a private garden on the north side reach over the verge into its swing, where the blade's underside is 2.65–2.74 m above the road: one at 48.721953, 11.201996 (10 m high, crown 4.9 m) and one at 48.721915, 11.201873 (15 m high, crown 5.5 m). The scan places a speed-limit sign on the north verge at 48.716189, 11.185985 (km 739.40), where the mapped limit changes between 70 and 100 km/h. It is not a mapped object, so its position is not confirmed. Two overpasses at Neuburg are tight. The first is Augsburger Straße at 48.716635, 11.177916 (km 739.99), with a footpath deck beside it (deck top 6.22 m). In the laser point cloud (December 2022) its deck top is 5.98 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.18 m deep (estimate 4.78 ± 0.40 m). The second is the farm-track bridge at 48.717579, 11.174398 (km 740.27), with a deck top of 5.85 m, clear only if the deck is less than 1.05 m deep (estimate 4.85 ± 0.40 m).
measures: Close all four arms of the roundabout and drive it the wrong way round, north of the island, with a pilot car stopping traffic on the north and south arms.
Take down the give-way sign and any bollard on the east-arm splitter island (48.72275, 11.20882) beforehand; the wheel path passes it with only 0.2 m to spare.

Before the convoy, check that the northern half of the island (48.72284, 11.20847) is clear of planting, mounds and signs above about 1.5 m, and that the tree clump on its southern half stays outside the blade sweep.

With the owner's consent and the Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt, crown-lift the two garden trees at 48.721915–48.721953, 11.201873–11.201996 so that no branch hangs lower than about 4.5 m over the north verge of the B 16.

Before the permit, get the registered clear heights of the Augsburger Straße bridge (48.716635, 11.177916) and the farm-track bridge (48.717579, 11.174398) from the Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt. Both estimates are within 0.1 m of the convoy's 4.8 m.
On the pre-run, check the speed-limit sign near 48.716189, 11.185985 and take the plate down if it stands within about 3.5 m of the convoy's centre line.

muenster-lech-kalkbauer.note: A long, gentle bend (radius about 295 m) on the two-lane B 16 between two junctions. Wheels stay on the asphalt and the blade swings at most 0.7 m past the edge. The wheels stay in the own lane; the 4.2 m root frame reaches up to 0.7 m into the oncoming lane on about 150 m, so oncoming traffic must be held.
measures: Hold traffic on both side roads at the junctions at each end of the bend (around 48.7297, 11.1586 and 48.7252, 11.1655) while the convoy runs in the oncoming lane.
Check that branches from the tree and hedge row on the outside (NE) of the bend do not reach over the road edge at blade height, and trim them if they do.

muenster-lech-hoefelhof.note: S-curve on the wide modern B 16 near Höfelhof (radius about 146 m). Using the oncoming lane for about 90 m (the blade root over the centre line on about 300 m), the wheels stay on the road and the blade swings at most 0.7 m past the edge. Its own lane is not enough, so the B 16 needs a short closure. Extended to start at km 742.95, the passage now includes the S-bend through the forest east of Höfelhof: a right-hand then a left-hand curve, both of radius about 300 m. With the front axle at km 743.563–743.707 (48.725664, 11.139926 to 48.725293, 11.138064), the blade's tail swings up to 1.17 m beyond the north edge. It also reaches 0.67 m at km 743.20–743.23 and 0.98 m at km 743.75–743.77. Against the traced paved surface it is up to 2.0 m over the whole passage. The north verge is a narrow strip in front of the forest edge. The scan finds no tree crown in the swing, but on the aerial photo of 23 May 2026 the forest stands close to the verge.
measures: Close both side-road junctions in the middle of the curve (the crossing minor road at about 48.720, 11.124) while the convoy uses the oncoming lane.
Check the tree strip between the B 16 and the parallel minor road on the outside of the northern bend, and prune any branches that reach over the verge into the blade-tip swing.

On the pre-run, check the forest edge on the north side of the B 16 between 48.725760, 11.144757 and 48.724985, 11.137362, and cut back branches that overhang the verge below about 4.5 m within 2.5 m of the edge.
With oncoming traffic held, run the convoy on the centre line through the left-hand bend (48.725600, 11.141453 to 48.725080, 11.137577). This brings the tail swing back towards the road.

muenster-lech-unterhausen.note: B 16 east of Unterhausen with wide curves (R ≈ 210 m); the blade swing stays near the road. The laser point cloud (Jan 2023) shows the Donautalbahn crossing over the B 16 on a bridge whose deck top is 7.33 m above the road, clear for any normal rail deck. The deciding point is the clear height under the local-road overbridge at 48.7166, 11.0871: its deck top is 7.12 m above the road in the laser point cloud, so 4.8 m is clear unless the deck is more than 2.3 m deep; confirm it at ≥ 4.8 m. Extended to km 746.47–747.85 and 748.95–749.28, the passage now includes three signs that the scan places on the north verge at the mapped speed-limit changes, where the blade's underside is 1.49–1.69 m: a speed-limit sign (274) at 48.714485, 11.105206 (km 746.72), an end-of-limit sign (278) at 48.715437, 11.102587 (km 746.94) and a speed-limit sign (274) at 48.715832, 11.101443 (km 747.04). None of them is a mapped object, so whether and exactly where they stand is not confirmed. The Sinninger Straße bridge at km 746.79 (deck top 7.15 m) is clear for any normal deck. At km 749.124–749.137 (48.715236, 11.074070) the blade swings 0.38 m over the grass of the north verge, which needs no action.
measures: Get the clear height of the local-road overbridge at 48.7166, 11.0871 from the Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt bridge records, or measure it on site, before the transport is permitted; if it is under 4.8 m the passage is blocked and the route must be changed.
Confirm in the permit that the convoy may cross the B 16 bridge over the railway at 48.716057, 11.081921 (axle loads); no clear-height check is needed there.

On the pre-run, locate the signs on the north verge of the westbound B 16 between 48.714450, 11.105300 and 48.715900, 11.101300. Have the Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt take down any plate within about 3.5 m of the convoy's centre line, or pass it on the centre line with oncoming traffic held.

muenster-lech-moos.note: Two-lane B 16 bypass with wide curves (minimum radius 282 m); wheels stay on the road and the blade barely swings out. Passage depends on four overpasses (two road, two farm-track): in the laser point cloud (Jan 2023) their deck tops are 6.28–6.96 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear if the decks are less than 1.48 m deep (Bertoldsheimer Straße: deck top 6.32 m, clear if under 1.52 m). The registered heights still need confirming. The convoy needs the oncoming lane on about 350 m and its blade root reaches over the centre line on about 800 m of the 3.2 km.
measures: Get the as-built clear heights of the four overpasses (48.709991/11.008532, 48.709437/11.019836, 48.708789/11.036841, 48.712863/11.044327) from Staatliches Bauamt Ingolstadt and confirm them on site, measuring across the full width the convoy uses, including the oncoming lane.
If any bridge has less than 4.80 m clear, plan to lower the transport height (lower the front unit or turn the blade root) before approaching, or get a detour approved before the permit is issued.

Close the B 16 to oncoming traffic between the junction west of spot1 (about 48.7100/11.004) and the start of the dual carriageway east of spot4 (48.7129/11.0443), because the convoy and its blade root run partly in the oncoming lane over these 3.2 km.

muenster-lech-feldheim.note: Sharp right turn off the westbound B 16 onto a 180° loop road (radius about 47 m) round a wooded pond, across the Feldheim roundabout and over the B 16 to the St 2047. The blade swings up to 20 m over fields; trees inside the loop decide passage. The 2.93 m height reading is spurious. The laser point cloud shows no deck over the convoy at that crossing, and the Niederschönenfelder Straße bridge deck top is 6.49 m above the road (clear if the deck is less than 1.69 m deep). Extended to start at km 759.92, the passage now includes the approach on the westbound B 16 under the St 2047 bridge, at 48.703268, 10.930421 (km 760.17), before the loop. This is the same bridge the convoy later crosses on top. The scan's clear height there, 4.97 ± 0.40 m (deck top 6.17 m above the road), comes only from the 20 cm surface model, not from the point cloud, so it is weak. Extended to km 762.21, the passage also includes the St 2047 southwards past the Donautalbahn crossing. There the blade swings 0.78 m beyond the edge at km 761.549–761.560 (48.701163, 10.932393) and 0.59 m at km 762.037–762.060 (48.698992, 10.938136), where it passes 0.41 m above a guide post at 48.698986, 10.938051. That post is a modelled standard post, not a mapped one.
measures: Fell or crown-lift the tree belt on the inside of the loop's north arc (about 48.7035, 10.9240-10.9246) and the tree row on the B 16 south verge at the loop junction (about 48.7024, 10.9243-10.9249), where the blade tail swings across the B 16.

At the roundabout, remove the give-way sign and the bollards on the west-arm splitter island (48.70367, 10.925284), let the convoy cut across the south-leg splitter island, and close the roundabout and the B 16/loop junction completely while the convoy passes.

Get the load rating of the St 2047 road bridge over the B 16 (about 48.7034, 10.9304) checked for the convoy's axle loads, and steer the rear dolly precisely there: the wheels clear the edge by only about 0.2 m.

Get the registered clear height under the St 2047 bridge at 48.703268, 10.930421 for the westbound B 16 lane from the Staatliches Bauamt Augsburg, or measure it. If it is under 4.8 m, the convoy cannot reach the loop exit this way.

No action for the small overswing on the St 2047 at 48.701163, 10.932393 and 48.698992, 10.938136. On the pre-run, check that the guide post at 48.698986, 10.938051 is a standard 1.05 m post (the blade clears it by 0.41 m), and that the trees beside the road at km 761.55–761.70 do not hang over the carriageway below about 4.5 m.
muenster-lech-feldheim.hard: a 77° turn into a 180° loop of radius ≈ 47 m with trees to fell inside the loop and on the B 16 verge, and only ≈ 0.2 m wheel margin on the St 2047 bridge

muenster-lech-unterpeiching.note: Rural stretch between two roundabouts with open fields between them. Wheels stay on the asphalt, but the convoy uses the whole roundabout width against traffic. The blade tip swings 22-25 m over both central islands. The young trees on those islands, and a verge tree at the second roundabout, decide whether the blade passes.
measures: Remove or temporarily cut back the young trees and shrubs on the western half of the central island at the roundabout near 48.67756,10.93527, and the planting on the island at 48.67363,10.91937; pruning alone is not enough within 25 m of the blade tip.

Check the blade's height over the single tree on the south-east verge between the east entry and the south exit of the second roundabout (around 48.6734,10.9197), and prune or remove it if the tip is lower than the crown.
Close every arm of both roundabouts while the convoy passes, because it drives straight across the circulating lane against the normal direction and the blade sweeps over the north and west entries.

muenster-lech-pessenburgheim.note: From the St 2047 the route follows an estate road, then narrow field tracks to the crane pad, with three right-angle turns. The blade cuts each inside corner by about 4 m and wheels leave the track by up to 3.5 m. Trees must be cleared at the wooded inside corner at 48.6143, 10.9345.
measures: At 48.614339, 10.934495, fell or cut back the woodland edge in a wedge of about 40 x 45 m south-east of the junction (needs landowner and forestry permits). Also identify the small structure on the woodland edge about 35 m south of the junction and remove it if it lies in the blade swing.
Remove the bench at the corner at 48.609164, 10.927673 and check the tree clump just north-east of it, which lies in the tail swing and the wheel run-out.

Confirm that the tracks from 48.6143, 10.9345 via 48.6106, 10.9348 and 48.6091, 10.9276 to the crane pad are built to wind-farm access standard and rated for the axle loads. On the photo they look like field tracks about 3 m wide that need widening and upgrading.
muenster-lech-pessenburgheim.hard: trees to fell in about 40 × 45 m of woodland at the inside corner (48.6143, 10.9345), three junction turns on narrow field tracks with up to 3.5 m wheel run-out

muenster-lech-warcislawiec.note: Straight four-lane S3 (S3/S6), southbound, under a wildlife overpass that also spans railway line 401 on its west side. The aerial photo shows the planted overpass with its wing walls, 39 m long along the road; OSM maps it as man_made=wildlife_crossing and the carriageways under it as covered. Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. The clear height is not measured: the laser data (GUGiK) see only the top of the cover, 8.30–8.51 m above the road, and the survey subtracts an assumed 3.0 m of deck and soil, giving 5.30 m ± 0.80. OSM tags the southbound covered section maxheight:signed=no (no height-limit sign); no street photo was found to confirm this. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the southbound lanes being at least 4.8 m. The low end of the estimate (4.5 m) does not rule out a problem. This is the first structure over the route after the plant.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the wildlife overpass over the southbound S3 carriageway (centre about 53.511628, 14.802840) from GDDKiA Oddział w Szczecinie (the S3 road manager), measured over the lane the convoy will use, and have it entered in the category VII oversize permit before the permit is issued.

If it is below 4.8 m over the right-hand lane but not over the left, ask GDDKiA for a closure of the left lane under escort so the convoy drives under the highest part of the opening. If no lane gives 4.8 m, the route from the plant needs another way to the A6 that does not use this section of the S3. Plan it before the permit is issued.

muenster-lech-kliniska-male.note: Straight S3 (S3/S6), southbound at Kliniska Małe, under a footbridge with long ramps along both sides of the road (aerial photo; OSM footway bridge). The convoy stays on the carriageway. In the laser point cloud (GUGiK, April 2022) the deck top is 5.76 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 0.96 m deep. A footbridge can be that slim, but no photo or record confirms it. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the southbound lanes being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the footbridge at 53.461342, 14.788000 over the southbound S3 lanes from GDDKiA Oddział w Szczecinie and have it entered in the category VII permit.
If it is below 4.8 m, agree a way round with GDDKiA before the permit is issued. First check, with a swept-path run, whether the parallel roads on both sides of the S3 here (aerial photo) are usable.

muenster-lech-zalom.note: The S3 just before it joins the A6 (OSM ref S3;S6, then A6;S3 from about 53.419200, 14.755800), heading south-west. The convoy first passes a 59 m wildlife overpass where the two carriageways run through separate openings (aerial photo; OSM man_made=wildlife_crossing, bridge=yes). About 850 m further on it passes under a narrow forest-road bridge (OSM service road, bridge:structure=beam). Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. Neither clear height is measured. The overpass estimate is the top of its cover, 8.25–8.40 m above the road, minus an assumed 3.0 m of deck and soil: 5.25 m ± 0.80. The forest-road bridge's deck top is 5.93 m above the road in the laser point cloud (GUGiK, September 2024), so 4.8 m is clear only if its deck is less than 1.13 m deep. Passage depends on both registered clear heights being at least 4.8 m over the south-west-bound lanes.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the wildlife overpass over the south-west-bound carriageway (centre about 53.420270, 14.759226) from GDDKiA Oddział w Szczecinie.
Get the registered clear height of the forest-road bridge at 53.416643, 14.748095 over the south-west-bound lanes from GDDKiA Oddział w Szczecinie. Put both figures in the category VII permit.

muenster-lech-kolowo.note: Straight, lit A6 with three lanes each way at Kołowo, under the narrow Kozia street bridge. The bridge crosses the motorway at a skew (aerial photo; OSM bridge:structure=beam). The convoy stays on the carriageway. In the laser point cloud (GUGiK, September 2024) the deck top is 6.02 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.22 m deep. That is plausible for a narrow street bridge but not confirmed. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the westbound lanes being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Kozia bridge at 53.368618, 14.693650 over the westbound A6 lanes from GDDKiA Oddział w Szczecinie and have it entered in the category VII permit.
If only some lanes give 4.8 m, ask GDDKiA to close the others for the convoy under escort so it uses the lane with the highest underside.

muenster-lech-radziszewo.note: Straight A6, westbound, inside an interchange (ramps on both sides on the aerial photo), under the Bielańska viaduct. OSM maps it as bridge=viaduct and bridge:structure=beam, and the viaduct also spans a ramp. The convoy stays on the carriageway. In the laser point cloud (GUGiK, September 2024) the deck top is 6.00 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.20 m deep. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the westbound lanes being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Bielańska viaduct at 53.339894, 14.570783 over the westbound A6 lanes from GDDKiA Oddział w Szczecinie for the category VII permit.

If it is below 4.8 m, check with a swept-path run whether the convoy can leave by the westbound off-ramp and rejoin by the on-ramp of the same interchange. The viaduct also spans a ramp (OSM way 36891348, about 53.340500, 14.570350), so that ramp's clear height must be checked too.

muenster-lech-kolbaskowo.note: Westbound A6 under the DK13 overpass at the Kołbaskowo junction (53.34067, 14.44384). The "signed height limit 4.0 m" is a map artefact, not a sign. It comes from maxheight=4.0 and traffic_sign=PL:B-16[4.0] on OSM way 385745754, the convoy's own westbound carriageway under the overpass (the same tags are on way 385745753, eastbound). The tags were added on 2021-02-21 in changeset 99692142 ("Poprawki tagów"), a desk edit whose sources were the Geoportal orthophoto, SIP and "knowledge"; no street photo was cited. Westbound street photos from August 2016 and June 2020 show the bridge face, both abutments and the approach, with no B-16 or other height sign. A real 4.0 m clearance would also contradict the laser and the photos. The structure is the 1930s Reichsautobahn overpass: a riveted steel plate-girder deck on two spans, with a steel pendulum pier in the median and a separate cycleway bridge alongside. In the GUGiK laser point cloud of 2022-04-12, the deck top over the westbound carriageway is 5.8–6.4 m above the A6: 5.99/6.16 m (minimum/median) over the outer merge lane, 5.90/6.09 m over the main right lane (the middle of three lanes under the bridge) and 5.81/6.02 m over the left lane. The deck is lowest over the north-west part of the DK13 roadway. Nothing hangs below the deck over the road. The underside is not in the laser, so it was measured on the June 2020 4K photo taken 56 m before the bridge (KartaView 2725142/828). Method: horizon from the lane lines, camera height 1.33 m from the 3-lane width, scale from the laser railing top at 7.45 m. Results: the riveted outer fascia girder's bottom is at about 6.0 m. The bottom flange of the stiffened girder or cross-girder visible behind it is at 4.8–5.1 m, depending on how far behind the fascia it sits. The underside silhouette against the sky puts every element in the north-west half of the deck at 5.1 m or more. Best estimate of the clear height over the convoy's lane: 4.9 ± 0.2 m. That is marginal for the 4.8 m convoy and agrees with the scan's 4.76 ± 0.45 m 'check'. Only the registered clear height can settle it. No ramp lets westbound traffic avoid the bridge: the Kołbaskowo on-ramp merges just before it. The junction is being rebuilt (Budimex contract, completion planned for 2027–2028), and the old DK13 junction is to be closed in stage II.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the DK13 overpass over the westbound A6 at the Kołbaskowo junction (53.34067, 14.44384), lane by lane, from GDDKiA Oddział Szczecin before the permit is issued. Open data gives 4.9 ± 0.2 m over the convoy's lane: the deck top is 5.9–6.2 m (laser 2022) and the girders hang 1.0–1.3 m below it (photo 2020).

If the registered height over the main right lane is below 4.8 m, check the outer merge lane: its deck top is about 0.1 m higher. If that is still too low, settle an alternative before the convoy reaches the junction. The westbound exit to DK13 leaves before the bridge, but no on-ramp rejoins the A6 after it, so a westbound vehicle cannot get round the bridge at this junction; the alternative would be a different border crossing, e.g. DK13 via Rosówek–Rosow (not surveyed here).

Ask GDDKiA and the Budimex site whether temporary height or lane restrictions apply on the A6 around the Kołbaskowo junction on the transport date; the junction and the A6 border section are being rebuilt.

No 4.0 m height restriction is posted for the convoy's road here. The OSM tag maxheight=4.0 / traffic_sign=PL:B-16[4.0] on ways 385745754 and 385745753 does not match the 2016 and 2020 street photos or the laser.

Plan the A6 works west of this passage. In June 2026 GDDKiA Szczecin reported a new viaduct under construction on the A6 border section, with traffic in both directions moved to the Berlin carriageway after the summer holidays. OSM (check date 12 February 2026) shows construction between about 53.337300, 14.420900 and 53.335800, 14.408700, roughly km 44.4–45.2 of the route and outside any passage. Agree lane widths, a closure and the escort for the contraflow with GDDKiA and the contractor.

muenster-lech-nadrensee.note: Straight A 11 with two concrete lanes each way near Nadrensee, heading west, under the Dorfstraße (VG 84) bridge. The bridge has two spans and a pier in the median (aerial photo; a KartaView photo of August 2016 in the convoy's direction shows no height-limit sign). Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. In the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern laser data (GeoBasis-DE/M-V) the deck top is 6.07 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.27 m deep. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the westbound lanes being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Dorfstraße bridge at 53.328047, 14.353272 over the westbound A 11 lanes from Autobahn GmbH Nordost in the VEMAGS permit.
If only one lane gives 4.8 m, name that lane in the permit and close the other for the convoy under escort.

muenster-lech-radewitz.note: Straight A 11 with two lanes each way at Radewitz, heading west, under a single-span farm-road bridge with no pier in the median. A KartaView photo of August 2016 in the convoy's direction shows a deck that gets deeper towards the abutments, and OSM tags the structure bridge:structure=arch. Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. In the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern laser data the deck top is 6.13 m above the road. The survey's 5.13 m ± 0.40 assumes a flat 1.0 m deck, but on a haunched or arched span the clear height over the outer lane and the hard shoulder is lower than at mid-span. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the lane the convoy uses being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the bridge at 53.298007, 14.159976 from Autobahn GmbH Nordost for each westbound lane and the hard shoulder, because the underside of a haunched single span is not level across the road. Put the lane the convoy uses in the VEMAGS permit.
If only the left lane gives 4.8 m, plan a closure of both westbound lanes with escort so the convoy can drive under the highest part of the span.

muenster-lech-hohenguestow.note: 3.6 km of straight A 11, heading south-west, through Kreuz Uckermark (straight on, no ramp) and past the Gramzow junction. Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. The survey marks five overbridges 'check'. Each estimate is the deck top above the road in the Brandenburg laser data (GeoBasis-DE/LGB) minus an assumed deck depth. The twin A 20 bridges at Kreuz Uckermark have a deck top 6.63 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear if the deck is less than 1.83 m deep. The figures for the others are a farm-track bridge 6.18 m (less than 1.38 m), Lützlower Damm 5.79 m (less than 0.99 m, the tightest of the five), Gramzower Straße (B 198) 6.20 m (less than 1.40 m) and a second farm-track bridge 5.94 m (less than 1.14 m). Panoramax photos of March 2025, taken in the opposite direction, show no height-limit sign on the north-east faces of Lützlower Damm, the B 198 bridge or the second track bridge. Lützlower Damm and the B 198 bridge are two-span beam bridges with a median pier. The second track bridge is a single span with no median pier, and its underside curves down towards the abutments, so its clear height over the outer lane and hard shoulder is lower than the mid-span estimate. The aerial photo also shows a cantilever sign about 60 m before the A 20 bridges, over the right-hand edge of the convoy's carriageway or its exit ramp to the A 20. It is not in the survey's clear-height list. Passage depends on all five registered clear heights, and the sign's, being at least 4.8 m over the lane used.
measures: Get the registered clear heights from Autobahn GmbH Nordost, over the south-west-bound A 11 lanes, for all five bridges, and put them in the VEMAGS permit: the A 20 bridges at 53.245626, 14.011832; the track bridge at 53.243752, 14.009031; Lützlower Damm at 53.236054, 13.997495; Gramzower Straße (B 198) at 53.230874, 13.989273; and the track bridge at 53.224534, 13.979259 (a haunched single span: ask for the figure over each lane).

Lützlower Damm decides the passage: 4.8 m is clear only if its deck is less than 1.0 m deep. If its registered height is below 4.8 m, plan the detour with Autobahn GmbH Nordost before the permit is issued. On the map the last junction before it is Kreuz Uckermark, 1.4 km earlier.

Get the clear height of the cantilever sign at about 53.246088, 14.012217 from Autobahn GmbH Nordost. Check whether its arm reaches over the lane the convoy will use or only over the exit ramp to the A 20.

muenster-lech-heidehof.note: Straight A 11 with two lanes each way through woodland near Heidehof, heading south-west, under the K 7318 bridge. A Panoramax photo of March 2025, taken in the opposite direction, shows a single span with no median pier. The underside curves down from a slim mid-span towards the abutments, and no height-limit sign is visible. Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. In the Brandenburg laser data (GeoBasis-DE/LGB) the deck top is 6.25 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear at mid-span only if the deck there is less than 1.45 m deep. Towards the abutments, over the right lane and the hard shoulder, the clear height is lower. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the lane the convoy uses being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the K 7318 bridge at 53.206251, 13.951134 from Autobahn GmbH Nordost for each south-west-bound lane and the hard shoulder (the underside of the haunched span is not level across the road), and name the lane the convoy uses in the VEMAGS permit.
If only the left lane gives 4.8 m, plan a closure of both lanes with escort so the convoy can drive near the middle of the span.

muenster-lech-trumpf.note: Straight A 11 with two lanes each way near Trumpf, heading south-west, through the 62 m Grünbrücke (wildlife overpass; OSM man_made=wildlife_crossing, name 'Grünbrücke'). Each carriageway runs through its own opening. A Panoramax photo of March 2025, taken inside the northbound opening, shows a concrete arch vault rising from a wall at the edge of the hard shoulder. The clear height is therefore greatest at mid-carriageway and falls towards the sides. Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. The clear height is not measured: the laser data see only the top of the cover, 7.37–7.83 m above the road, and the survey subtracts an assumed 3.0 m of deck and soil. That gives 4.37 m ± 0.80, below the 4.8 m the convoy needs and the lowest estimate between km 0 and 100. Passage depends on the registered clear height of the southbound opening over the lane used being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height and the arch profile of the southbound opening of the Grünbrücke (centre about 53.178136, 13.925846) from Autobahn GmbH Nordost across the full width (right lane, left lane, hard shoulder) before the VEMAGS application.
If the right lane is below 4.8 m but the middle of the opening is not, plan a closure of both southbound lanes with escort so the convoy drives along the highest line of the arch.

If no line through the opening gives 4.8 m, the A 11 cannot be used here. Plan a detour from the last junction before the overpass with Autobahn GmbH Nordost and the district road authority (Landkreis Uckermark) before the permit is issued.

muenster-lech-neuhaus.note: Straight A 11 with two lanes each way near Neuhaus, heading south, through the 51 m Grünbrücke Schorfheide-Chorin (OSM; a wildlife overpass with a separate opening for each carriageway and rounded portals on the aerial photo). Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. The clear height is not measured: the top of the cover is 9.14–9.42 m above the road, and the survey subtracts an assumed 3.0 m of deck and soil, giving 6.14 m ± 0.80. Even the low end of that range (5.3 m) is above the 4.8 m the convoy needs, so the risk is low. If the openings are arched like the Grünbrücke near Trumpf, though, the clearance over the hard shoulder is lower than at mid-lane. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the lane used being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the southbound opening of the Grünbrücke Schorfheide-Chorin (centre about 53.062477, 13.840303) from Autobahn GmbH Nordost together with the other A 11 structures in the VEMAGS permit. Name the lane if the opening is arched.

muenster-lech-redernswalde.note: Straight southbound A 11 under the Angermünder Straße (L 239) overpass at km 100.96. Wheels and blade stay on the road. In the Brandenburg 1 m surface and terrain models (LGB bDOM over DGM1; no open laser point cloud covers this spot) the deck top is 5.98 m above the A 11, so the convoy's 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.18 m deep (on 18 Brandenburg bridges of this route measured both ways, that method read between 0.42 m lower and 0.16 m higher than the laser point cloud); the survey's 4.78 ± 0.40 m assumes a 1.2 m deck. The aerial photo (LGB) shows a beam bridge across both carriageways, and a March 2025 street photo (Panoramax) shows a central pier in the median; no height-limit sign can be made out. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the southbound lane being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Angermünder Straße (L 239) overpass at 53.037291, 13.832492 from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Nordost, measured over the southbound lane the convoy will use, before the permit is issued.

If the registered height is below 4.9 m, survey it on site lane by lane and drive the lane with the most clearance at walking pace behind a height-pole vehicle; if every lane is below 4.8 m, plan a detour before km 100 (not assessed here).

muenster-lech-althuettendorf.note: Straight southbound A 11 past Althüttendorf under three flagged overpasses; wheels and blade stay on the road. The Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) puts the deck tops over the convoy's band 6.07 m above the road at Neugrimnitzer Straße (K 6016, km 108.46; 5.99 m at its lower edge), 6.30 m at Zu den Ihlowbergen (km 109.30) and 6.28 m at the B 198 bridge of the Joachimsthal junction (km 110.60; 6.14 m at its lower edge). So 4.8 m is clear only if those decks are less than 1.19 m, 1.50 m and 1.34 m deep at their lowest edge; Neugrimnitzer Straße is the tightest. The survey's lower 5.88 m for Zu den Ihlowbergen came from the surface model. March 2025 street photos (Panoramax) near the first two show old beam bridges with a central pier and no height-limit sign on their faces. A fourth overpass, the track bridge at km 110.14 (deck top 6.42 m), is not flagged. Passage depends on the registered clear heights of the three flagged bridges being at least 4.8 m over the southbound lane.
measures: Get the registered clear heights of the overpasses at 52.970651, 13.815986 (Neugrimnitzer Straße, K 6016), 52.963298, 13.813280 (Zu den Ihlowbergen) and 52.952315, 13.806347 (B 198) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Nordost for the southbound lane; Neugrimnitzer Straße first, because its deck may be no deeper than 1.19 m at its lower edge.

If the B 198 bridge is under 4.8 m, the Joachimsthal junction does not help: on the aerial photo all its ramps join the A 11 north of the B 198, so a southbound convoy cannot leave before the bridge and rejoin after it there.
If Neugrimnitzer Straße or Zu den Ihlowbergen is under 4.8 m, plan a detour from the junction north of them before the permit is applied for (not assessed here).

muenster-lech-buckow.note: Southbound A 11 under a narrow farm and forest track bridge between Joachimsthal and the Britz/Chorin area (52.89710, 13.72717; OSM way 90310522, highway=track, bridge=yes). The bridge is a slender two-span concrete beam, about 3 m wide, with a round pier in the median and green railings. It spans both carriageways (aerial photo and Panoramax street photos of 2025-03-14). The 3.50 ± 0.40 m 'too low' was not measured in the laser point cloud. It is the bDOM image-matching surface model ('top 4.5 m') minus the typical 1.0 m deck depth for a track. Image matching cannot resolve a 3 m wide deck: the passage's own surface samples along the bridge line reach only 3.1–3.4 m above the road at the deck. The LGB airborne laser tile als_33414-5861 measures the deck top over the southbound lanes at 6.80–7.0 m above the road (366 points, minimum 6.80, median 6.97), with the railing at 8.2 m. Nothing hangs below the deck between the road and 5.5 m. A box lorry caught on the road 15–29 m south of the bridge reads as a flat 4.0 m roof in the same cloud, which confirms the laser height scale. Even with a generous 1.3 m deck depth, the clear height is at least 5.5 m. Best estimate: 5.8 ± 0.4 m, with the usual 1.0 ± 0.4 m deck depth of a track bridge. The overpass is not a blocker for the 4.8 m convoy.
measures: None for height: the track bridge over the A 11 at 52.89710, 13.72717 clears the 4.8 m convoy by at least 0.7 m (deck top 6.8 m above the southbound lanes in the LGB laser point cloud).
Optional: confirm the registered clear height with Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Nordost when the route list is checked for the permit; no special action is expected.
If the registered height were under 4.8 m, the detour would have to leave the A 11 before km 118: the Werbellin junction lies about 0.9 km past the bridge, so it cannot be used to get round it.

muenster-lech-woltersdorf.note: Straight southbound A 11 under the bridge of the Wandlitz junction (14) at km 142.25. The structure is the junction's two-lane, two-way link road between its ramps, not a motorway as the survey labels it. Wheels and blade stay on the road. The Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) puts the deck top 6.16 m above the A 11 over the convoy's band, falling to 6.07 m at the deck's lower edge, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.27 m deep there; the survey's 4.80 ± 0.50 m (from the surface model's 6.30 m) assumes a 1.5 m deck, which would leave only about 4.6 m. A March 2025 street photo (Panoramax) shows an old concrete beam bridge with a central pier and no height-limit sign on its face. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the southbound lane being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Wandlitz junction bridge at 52.728306, 13.540381 from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Nordost for the southbound lane before the permit is issued; if it is under 4.9 m, survey it on site under the lower deck edge.

If it is under 4.8 m, do not count on the junction to get round it: the southbound exit and entry meet the link road west of the bridge (around 52.728583, 13.538870) about 70 m apart with a hairpin between them, which an 84 m blade cannot take without a swept-path check.

muenster-lech-schmetzdorf.note: Straight southbound A 11 at Schmetzdorf under two road overpasses, each with a separate foot and cycle bridge beside it. Wheels and blade stay on the road. The Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) puts the deck tops over the convoy's band 6.22 m above the road at Wandlitzer Chaussee (L 304, km 146.49; 6.14 m at the lowest edge) and 6.17 m at Schönower Chaussee (L 30, km 147.65; 6.06 m at the lower edge), so 4.8 m is clear only if those decks are less than 1.34 m and 1.26 m deep at their lowest edge. The survey's 5.18 m and 5.09 m came from the surface model, which read these decks 0.12–0.16 m too high. No street photo of the bridge faces was found. Passage depends on the registered clear heights being at least 4.8 m over the southbound lane.
measures: Get the registered clear heights of the Wandlitzer Chaussee overpass (52.691797, 13.557824) and the Schönower Chaussee overpass (52.681815, 13.562889), with their side foot and cycle bridges, from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Nordost for the southbound lane.
If either is under 4.9 m, survey it on site under the lower deck edge and use the lane with the most clearance.

muenster-lech-lindenhof.note: Straight six-lane A 10 (westbound) under three structures in Berlin-Buch, just inside the Berlin boundary: the railway bridge carrying the Stettiner Bahn (line 6081) and the S-Bahn (line 6002) at km 160.46, the single-track Heidekrautbahn (RB 27, line 6500) at km 160.89 and the Hobrechtsfelder Chaussee at km 161.72. Wheels and blade stay on the road. In the 1 m surface and terrain models (LGB bDOM over DGM1; the open Brandenburg laser point cloud does not cover Berlin) the deck tops are 5.97 m, 6.43 m and 6.01 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the decks are less than 1.17 m, 1.63 m and 1.21 m deep (that method was off by −0.42 to +0.16 m against the laser point cloud on this route's Brandenburg bridges). A ballasted rail deck is often deeper than 1.17 m, so the Stettiner Bahn bridge (survey 4.47 ± 0.60 m) is the most likely real height limit between km 100 and 256. OSM maps one Stettiner Bahn track on it as under construction and tags the A 10 under it with no posted height limit. No street photos were found. Passage depends on the registered clear heights, above all of the Stettiner Bahn bridge, being at least 4.8 m over the lane used.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Stettiner Bahn / S-Bahn bridge over the A 10 at 52.626589, 13.481990 for every westbound lane from Autobahn GmbH Nordost / DB InfraGO, and route the convoy in the lane with the most clearance; if every lane is under 4.8 m, plan a lower transport setup or another route around the northern Berliner Ring before the permit is applied for.

Ask DB InfraGO about the works on the Stettiner Bahn bridge (a track is mapped as under construction): falsework, scaffolding or protective netting under the deck on the transport date would reduce the clearance.

Get the registered clear heights of the Heidekrautbahn bridge at 52.628148, 13.475918 (OSM names Niederbarnimer Eisenbahn AG and DB InfraGO AG as operators) and of the Hobrechtsfelder Chaussee bridge at 52.629655, 13.463907 from Autobahn GmbH Nordost.
If the registered heights are not available in time, measure the three deck tops in the Berlin laser point cloud or on site.

muenster-lech-ploetzin.note: Almost straight southbound A 10 (the 1936 section of the Berliner Ring, two lanes and a hard shoulder) near Plötzin. At km 237.96 the blade passes up to 0.48 m beyond the traced edge over about 4 m², on the right (west) side around 52.380020, 12.817290. There the traced edge is the outer edge of the paved hard shoulder (about 2.2–2.5 m wide beyond the edge line on the LGB aerial photo), so the overhang is over the grass verge, not over a paved shoulder, at blade height (1.6 m and more); the scan found no sign, post or tree crown in its way. Trees on the west verge stand close to the shoulder there (crowns and shadows reach its edge on the aerial photo), so the only check is for overhanging branches. The other point is the overpass at km 239.05, which the survey calls Plötziner Straße and OSM Bochower Weg (40 t limit): the Brandenburg laser point cloud (LGB) puts its deck top 6.25 m above the road (6.22 m at the lower edge), so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.42 m deep. A June 2025 street photo (Panoramax) on the other carriageway at km 237.99 shows roadworks with a temporary concrete barrier along the median. Passage depends on the overpass's registered clear height being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the overpass at 52.370353, 12.815956 (Bochower Weg in OSM, Plötziner Straße in the survey) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Nordost for the southbound lane.

At km 237.96 (around 52.380020, 12.817290), check before the run that no branches from the tree belt on the west verge reach within 1 m of the hard shoulder's outer edge between 1.5 m and 5 m above the road, or drive 0.5 m further left over these 100 m.
Check Autobahn GmbH's roadworks plan for this stretch for the transport date: a temporary median barrier narrows the lanes and would change the convoy's line.

muenster-lech-reesdorf.note: Straight six-lane A 9, southbound, under the Grünbrücke Beelitz, a 58 m wildlife overpass (km 257.131–257.189). Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. The survey puts its clear height at 5.96 m ± 0.8: in the 1 m laser terrain (DGM1, LGB) the top of the cover is 8.96–9.38 m above the road, and the survey takes off 3.0 m of deck and soil. So 4.8 m is clear unless deck and soil together are more than 4.16 m deep. That is likely but not confirmed. A 2025 street photo (Panoramax, northbound side) shows a straight concrete deck face over the motorway and no height-limit sign. OSM tags the structure as an arch, so a vaulted soffit that is lower over the outer lanes is not ruled out. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the southbound lane used being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Grünbrücke Beelitz over the southbound A 9 (portals at 52.241969, 12.916541 and 52.241460, 12.916724) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Nordost, for each lane and including anything fixed under the deck (lights, signs, cameras). Drive in the lane with the most clearance.
If the registered height is under 4.8 m, settle the route before the permit is applied for: the motorway has no way around a 58 m covered section.

muenster-lech-neue-muehle.note: Straight six-lane A 9, southbound, under the B 102 bridge and the separate foot and cycle path bridge beside it (km 280.375). Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. In the 1 m laser terrain (DGM1, LGB) the deck top is 6.52 m above the road. The survey takes off 1.3 m of deck and gets 5.22 m ± 0.45, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.72 m deep. A 2025 street photo (Panoramax, northbound side) shows a slender concrete beam bridge with a pier in the median and no height-limit sign on its face. OSM maps a sign gantry over the southbound carriageway 100 m before the passage (km 279.83). The survey does not list it. Passage depends on the registered clear heights of both bridges, and of that gantry, being at least 4.8 m over the lane used.
measures: Get the registered clear heights over the southbound A 9 of the B 102 bridge (52.096071, 12.691203) and the path bridge beside it (52.096091, 12.691295) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Nordost, lane by lane. Drive in the lane with the most clearance.

Get the clear height of the sign gantry mapped across the southbound carriageway at 52.099346, 12.697299 to 52.099465, 12.697099 (about km 279.83, OSM way 979356388). It lies just outside the passage and the survey does not measure it.

muenster-lech-werdermuehle.note: Straight six-lane A 9, southbound, under the Grünbrücke Niemegk, a 62 m wildlife overpass (km 284.423–284.485). Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. The survey puts its clear height at 5.64 m ± 0.8: in the 1 m laser terrain (DGM1, LGB) the top of the cover is 8.64–8.83 m above the road, and the survey takes off 3.0 m of deck and soil. So 4.8 m is clear unless deck and soil together are more than 3.84 m deep. That is likely but not confirmed. A 2025 street photo (Panoramax, northbound side) shows a flat concrete deck face spanning the motorway and no height-limit sign. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the southbound lane used being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the Grünbrücke Niemegk over the southbound A 9 (portals at 52.067241, 12.656542 and 52.066723, 12.656207) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Nordost, for each lane and including anything fixed under the deck. Drive in the lane with the most clearance.
If the registered height is under 4.8 m, settle the route before the permit is applied for: the motorway has no way around a 62 m covered section.

muenster-lech-koeselitz.note: Straight six-lane A 9, southbound, with a hard shoulder on the right. The scan found the blade 0.62 m beyond the edge (km 299.733–299.755, and 0.33 m at km 299.651). That is a mapping artefact. On the right, the route's traced edge lies 4.0 m from the route line, and the passage's paved trace ends 3.4–4.2 m from it. Both are inside the right-hand lane, 0.5–1.3 m short of its solid edge line, which the aerial photo (LVermGeo DOP20) puts about 4.7 m right of the route line. Beyond that line the photo shows the paved hard shoulder, about 3 m wide, with the verge further out. The convoy runs in the right-hand lane, so its blade reaches at most about to the solid edge line and stays over pavement. No trees reach over the road here.
measures: No action for the blade: keep the convoy in the right-hand lane between 51.974417, 12.499752 and 51.974339, 12.499457 (km 299.73–299.76). The hard shoulder beside it must be free of stopped vehicles when the convoy passes.

muenster-lech-koeselitz-2.note: Straight six-lane A 9, southbound, under the B 107 bridge at the junction for Coswig and the foot and cycle path bridge beside it (km 302.597). Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. In the 1 m laser terrain (DGM1, LVermGeo) the deck top is 6.54 m above the road. The survey takes off 1.3 m of deck and gets 5.24 m ± 0.45, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.74 m deep. A 2025 street photo (Panoramax, northbound side) shows a slender beam bridge with a pier in the median and no height-limit sign. The 3.33 m reading at km 302.164 is a vehicle in the surface model, as the page says. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the southbound lane used being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear heights over the southbound A 9 of the B 107 bridge (51.961178, 12.464250) and the path bridge beside it (51.961134, 12.464169) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Ost, lane by lane. Drive in the lane with the most clearance.

If either bridge is under 4.8 m, run a swept-path check of the junction before the permit is applied for: can the convoy leave by the southbound off-ramp and cross the B 107 straight onto the on-ramp under police control? The ramp layout is not confirmed here.

muenster-lech-vockerode.note: Straight six-lane A 9, southbound, at Vockerode. Just south of a short A 9 bridge (km 317.27–317.30), the scan found the wheels 0.49 m and the blade 0.94 m beyond the edge (km 317.317–317.352). Further on it found the wheels 0.32 m and the blade 0.71 m beyond the edge (km 317.490–317.522). Both are mapping artefacts. There the right edge of the route's carriageway trace lies only 4.5–5.8 m right of the route line. The aerial photo (LVermGeo DOP20) shows three lanes and a paved hard shoulder out to the right edge line, about 10 m right of the route line. The passage's own paved trace covers the full width, and its card shows no blade beyond the edge. Wheels and blade stay on asphalt, with no obstacle in the swing.
measures: No action for wheels or blade: keep the convoy in its lane between 51.857248, 12.345931 and 51.856169, 12.343519.

Include the two A 9 bridges the convoy crosses in this passage in the permit's load check as usual: km 317.27–317.30 (around 51.857391, 12.346248) and km 317.71–317.73 (around 51.855198, 12.341304). Neither limits height or width.

muenster-lech-brehna.note: Straight six-lane A 9, southbound, through the B 100 junction near Brehna. The convoy passes under four structures: the two B 100 bridges (km 354.155 and 354.175; deck tops 7.34 m above the road, clear for any normal deck), the bridge that carries the on-ramp towards Berlin over the A 9 (km 354.335), and a footbridge (km 354.635). The scan flags the ramp bridge. In the 1 m laser terrain (DGM1, LVermGeo) its deck top is 6.73 m above the road. With 1.5 m of deck taken off, the survey gives 5.23 m ± 0.5, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.93 m deep. A June 2025 street photo (Panoramax, southbound) shows a multi-span concrete beam bridge with piers beside the carriageway and in the median, and no height-limit sign on its face. The footbridge's 11.6 m in the page is wrong. Street photos show a steel arch over a deck hung from it, and OSM tags it as an arch bridge, so the 12.43 m 'top' is the arch crown. The walkway deck hangs much lower, and its clear height is not measured. Passage depends on the registered clear heights of the ramp bridge and the footbridge deck being at least 4.8 m over the southbound lane used.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the on-ramp bridge over the southbound A 9 at 51.553855, 12.188600 from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Ost, lane by lane. Drive in the lane with the most clearance.
Get the registered clear height of the arch footbridge's deck over the southbound A 9 at 51.551157, 12.189494 (km 354.635), including its hangers and lighting. The survey has no valid figure for it.
If either is under 4.8 m, plan the detour before the permit is applied for. The junction's ramps have not been checked against the convoy's swept path.

muenster-lech-doberstau.note: Straight six-lane A 9, southbound, under the S 4 state-road bridge (km 358.69). Wheels and blade stay on the carriageway. In the page the deck top is 6.35 m above the road, from the Saxony surface model over terrain sampled every 8 m. With 1.2 m of deck taken off, the survey gives 5.15 m ± 0.4, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.55 m deep. A point-by-point check in GeoSN's height service (terrain and surface model) confirms the figure despite the 8 m terrain in the page. The road under the bridge is at 103.8–103.9 m above sea level, and the deck top is 6.31–7.04 m above it: lowest (6.31 m) on the median side, and 6.46 m or more 4 m right of the route line. A June 2025 street photo (Panoramax, southbound) shows a concrete beam bridge with a central pier in the median and no height-limit sign. Passage depends on the registered clear height over the southbound lane used being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the S 4 bridge over the southbound A 9 at 51.515214, 12.197619 from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Ost, lane by lane. Drive in the lane with the most clearance.
If it is under 4.8 m, plan another route for this stretch before the permit is applied for.

muenster-lech-werlitzsch.note: Straight A 9, southbound, through the Schkeuditzer Kreuz (A 9/A 14). The convoy stays on the A 9. It passes under a two-lane slip-road bridge (km 368.570) and then the A 14 bridges (km 368.79; 52 m, deck tops 7.15 m above the road, 5.65 m estimated, clear). The slip-road bridge is in question. In the page its deck top is 6.56 m above the road, from the Saxony surface model over terrain sampled every 8 m. With 1.5 m of deck taken off, the survey gives 5.06 m ± 0.5, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.76 m deep. A point-by-point check in GeoSN's height service (terrain and surface model) confirms the figure despite the 8 m terrain in the page. The deck falls in the direction of travel, and its top is 6.42–7.24 m above the A 9: lowest (6.42 m) at the downhill edge on the median side, and 6.58 m or more 5 m right of the route line. A June 2025 street photo (Panoramax, southbound) shows the A 9 under the slip-road bridge, which stands on a round pier, and the long A 14 bridge beyond it, with no height-limit sign visible. Passage depends on the slip-road bridge's registered clear height over the southbound lane used being at least 4.8 m.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the slip-road bridge over the southbound A 9 at 51.429950, 12.199476 from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Ost, lane by lane. Drive in the lane with the most clearance.
Check whether any overhead sign gantry spans the southbound A 9 inside the interchange, between 51.433783, 12.201558 and 51.427020, 12.197648. The survey neither maps nor measures one.

muenster-lech-rippach.note: Straight A 9, southbound, through the Dreieck Rippachtal (A 9/A 38). The convoy stays on the A 9 and passes under three neighbouring bridges at km 393.33–393.37: a one-lane slip road to the A 9 towards München and Erfurt, the two A 38 carriageways, and a two-lane slip road. In the 1 m laser terrain (DGM1, LVermGeo) their deck tops are 6.68 m, 6.85 m and 6.73 m above the road. With 1.5 m of deck taken off, the survey gives 5.18 m, 5.35 m and 5.23 m ± 0.5. So 4.8 m is clear only if the decks are less than 1.88 m, 2.05 m and 1.93 m deep. A further bridge at km 393.692 has its deck top 8.01 m above the road (6.51 m estimated) and is clear. A June 2025 street photo (Panoramax, southbound) shows multi-span concrete beam bridges with piers beside the carriageway and no height-limit sign. Passage depends on the registered clear heights of the slip-road bridges, and of the A 38 bridge between them, being at least 4.8 m over the southbound lane used.
measures: Get the registered clear heights of the two slip-road bridges over the southbound A 9 (51.237563, 12.059478 at km 393.332 and 51.237258, 12.059174 at km 393.372) and of the A 38 bridge between them (51.237410, 12.059326) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Ost, lane by lane. Drive in the lane with the most clearance under all three.
Check whether any overhead sign gantry spans the southbound A 9 inside the interchange, between 51.240854, 12.062758 and 51.234748, 12.056709. The survey neither maps nor measures one.

muenster-lech-koesslitzwiedebach.note: Six-lane A 9 in a gentle curve (minimum radius about 720 m), starting on the A 9 bridge over the B 87/B 91. The convoy stays in the right lane and the blade stays over the paved surface (passage survey: blade beyond the edge none).
