The scan's trouble, the blade 0.29 m above a 1.40 m km post at km 401.567, is a mapping artefact: the km 150.0 milestone is mapped in OpenStreetMap on the southbound lanes (node 8223875902, 51.173808, 12.000873), and the scan placed it at the edge of the traced surface, 2.2 m right of the convoy's line, which on the aerial photo is paved hard shoulder. The real km board stands beyond the paved surface, out of the blade's reach whatever its height. The page's guard-rail conflict at km 401.148 is also an artefact: that guard rail (OSM way 1459291746) runs along the B 87/B 91 underneath the A 9 bridge (A 9 ways 19830638 and 19830640, bridge, layer 1), not on the motorway.
measures: No action for the km post at 51.173829, 12.000792 (km 401.567): keep the convoy in the right lane, which leaves the paved hard shoulder between the blade and the verge; nothing needs removing.
Strike the passage's measure to dismantle about 5 m of guard rail at 51.177244, 12.003181 (km 401.148): the guard rail is on the B 87/B 91 below the A 9 bridge, not in the swept path.
Confirm in the VEMAGS permit with Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Ost that the convoy may cross the A 9 bridge over the B 87/B 91 at about 51.1772, 12.0032 with its axle loads.

muenster-lech-kleinhelmsdorf.note: Straight six-lane A 9 at Kleinhelmsdorf (minimum radius about 6 km). Wheels and blade stay on the paved surface and the passage survey finds no conflict. The scan's trouble, the blade 0.31 m above a 1.40 m km post at km 418.531, is a mapping artefact: the km 167.0 milestone is mapped on the southbound lanes (OSM node 4815454927, 51.030180, 11.936999), and the scan placed it at the edge of the traced surface beside the right lane, which on the aerial photo is the outer edge of the paved hard shoulder. The real board stands beyond the paved surface, where the blade does not reach.
measures: No action: keep the convoy in the right lane past 51.030202, 11.936918 (km 418.531); no km post or guide post needs removing.

muenster-lech-heideland.note: Six-lane A 9 at Heideland. All three scan troubles come from a traced right edge in the route data that is too narrow: between km 423.50 and 423.70 it lies only 3.9 m right of the route line, while the passage's own traced paved surface, and the aerial photo, put the outer edge of the southbound carriageway 5.8-8.9 m out. So the blade 'beyond the edge' (0.55 m, front axle at km 423.602-423.624) is over the carriageway, and the passage survey finds no overswing. The km post (km 172.0, OSM node 1830253600, itself mapped on the lanes) and the guide post (a standard one the survey adds 0.5 m beyond that edge, not a mapped one) are placed from the same edge; on the photo both scan positions lie on the lanes, about 5 m inside the outer guard rail, so neither marks a real obstacle. The page's lane-2 measure (100 m, 'it eases the line') follows the route line's sideways jog at km 423.58-423.62 caused by that edge; the photo shows the full carriageway width there.
measures: No action for the km post (50.988818, 11.908188) or the guide post (50.988737, 11.908038): both scan positions are on the paved carriageway; the real km 172.0 board and guide posts stand beyond the paved surface, out of the blade's reach.
Keep the convoy in the right lane through km 423.50-423.70 (50.989286, 11.909030 to 50.988105, 11.906886); the lane-2 closure on the passage page is not needed for the geometry.

muenster-lech-klengel.note: Six-lane A 9 in gentle curves through woodland at Klengel, just south of the Kuhberg rest area. Wheels and blade stay on the paved surface: the passage's traced paved surface covers the whole carriageway with both shoulders, and the passage survey finds no overswing. The scan's 'blade beyond the edge' (1.33 m with the front axle at km 430.068-430.098, 0.58 m at km 431.145-431.163) comes from the route line shifting 1.9 m sideways between km 430.04 and 430.12 against a left edge traced only 4.6-5.2 m out; it is an artefact. The 'mapped object inside the carriageway' at km 431.153 is not visible on the aerial photo, which shows open lanes there. The real open point is the farm-track bridge over the A 9 at km 431.024 (OSM bridge:ref '5037 518/0 - 120 Ü1'): the survey has no laser point cloud for Thuringia and its clear height is not measured.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the farm-track bridge at 50.946671, 11.833935 (km 431.024, structure 5037 518 per OpenStreetMap) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Ost, over the southbound right lane, and confirm at least 4.8 m before the permit; if it is lower, use the lane with the most clearance.

No action for the overswing at km 430.068-430.098 (50.954588, 11.838892 to 50.954357, 11.838676) and km 431.145-431.163 (50.945579, 11.833723): the carriageway and its paved shoulders are continuous there on the photo.
Strike the 'mapped object inside the carriageway' check at 50.945541, 11.833685 (km 431.153); the pre-run drive covers it.

muenster-lech-tautendorf.note: Six-lane A 9 over the Tautendorfer Brücke and up the following climb of up to about 3.7 % (route height profile). Wheels and blade stay on the paved surface (passage survey: no overswing). Both scan troubles are km posts: km 193.5 on the bridge (front axle at km 444.991, 0.09 m free) and km 195.5 (km 447.041, 0.03 m free). Their milestones are mapped on the lanes (OSM nodes 2681226413 and 1598106888) and the scan put them on the right lane's edge line, with the paved hard shoulder still beyond them on the aerial photo, so both are artefacts. The page's other points are artefacts too: the 15 % grade is the bare-earth terrain (DGM1) in the valley under the bridge, up to about 27 m below the road between km 444.94 and 445.21, so no pusher tractor is needed; the 'building at the road edge' near km 444.740 and the 'mapped object inside the carriageway' at km 446.286 show nothing on the photo. One structure is missing from the survey: a gantry spanning the southbound carriageway at km 447.112 (OSM way 981688006, visible on the photo).
measures: Get the clear height of the gantry over the southbound carriageway at 50.810237, 11.895124 (km 447.112) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Ost, or measure it on site; the survey does not list it.

Strike the pusher-tractor measure: the 15 % grade is the terrain under the Tautendorfer Brücke (about 50.827164, 11.880525 to 50.824828, 11.881784), not the road. Confirm in the permit that the convoy may cross the bridge with its axle loads.

No action for the km posts at 50.826786, 11.880697 and 50.810909, 11.894820, the building check at 50.829591, 11.879023 or the mapped object at 50.816527, 11.889237: nothing stands on the paved surface there on the photo; keep the convoy in the right lane.

muenster-lech-raila.note: Straight six-lane A 9 at Raila (minimum radius about 490 m). All four scan troubles come from a traced right edge in the route data that cuts into the right lane: between km 482.90 and 482.97 it lies only 2.6-3.0 m right of the route line, inside the right lane, while the passage's own traced paved surface reaches 5.7-6.0 m out and the aerial photo shows the paved hard shoulder beyond the lane. The wheels 0.27 m beyond the edge (km 482.973-482.989), the blade 0.70 m beyond the edge (km 482.968-483.003, and 0.33 m at km 482.725) and the guide post (a standard one the survey adds 0.5 m beyond that edge, not a mapped one; its position at 50.514898, 11.797979 is on the carriageway) are artefacts; the passage survey finds wheels and blade on the paved surface. The page's measure to close lane 2 for about 160 m rests on the same edge.
measures: Strike the lane-2 closure: keep the convoy in the right lane through km 482.90-483.06 (50.515443, 11.798072 to 50.514009, 11.797948); the right lane and the paved hard shoulder are continuous there on the photo.
No guide post or km post needs removing: real guide posts stand at the verge or on the guard rail, beyond the paved surface and out of the blade's reach.

muenster-lech-blintendorf.note: Straight six-lane A 9 north of exit 29 Bad Lobenstein. The flagged sign 448 (OSM node 10090681425, 50.456065, 11.799088) is the advance sign 'exit 29 Bad Lobenstein 1000 m', and it is not a ground-mounted plate: a 2026 street photo (Panoramax) shows it on a single tall post at the outer verge with a cantilever arm, the plate hanging high above the edge of the southbound carriageway, and the aerial photo shows the post beyond the paved edge and the plate's shadow on the hard shoulder. The scan modelled it as a 4.4 m wide plate with its lower edge 1.5 m above the ground, centred 0.5 m beyond the paved edge, hence '3.02 m too low'; in reality the blade passes under the plate, whose lower edge is not measured. The farm-track bridge over the A 9 at km 490.158 has no measured clear height either. The page's 'steel plates where the wheels leave the paved area by up to 0.9 m' is an artefact: north of the sign the passage's traced paved surface follows the lane's edge line and leaves out the paved hard shoulder, which is visible on the photo.
measures: Measure the lower edge of the cantilever sign plate at 50.456065, 11.799088 (km 490.03) and how far it reaches over the hard shoulder and the right lane, or get both from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Ost. The convoy needs 4.8 m under any part of the plate the blade passes; if it is lower, move the convoy left (lane 2, closed by the escort) so the blade passes beside the plate.
Get the registered clear height of the farm-track bridge at 50.454862, 11.799153 (km 490.158, OSM way 379958649) from Autobahn GmbH Niederlassung Ost and confirm at least 4.8 m over the lane used.

Strike the steel-plates measure: the wheels stay in the right lane, and the paved area they appear to leave north of the sign (about 50.4595, 11.8004 to 50.4561, 11.7992) is the tracing along the edge line, with the paved hard shoulder beyond it.
Also check the clear height of the sign gantry over the southbound carriageway at 50.451360, 11.799553 (km 490.55, 120 m after the passage end, the '500 m' gantry), which the survey does not list.

muenster-lech-sachsenvorwerk.note: Six-lane A 9 in a curve (minimum radius about 370 m) at Sachsenvorwerk, north of exit 30 Rudolphstein. The scan's blade overswing of 0.36 m over 2 m (front axle at km 495.242) disappears with the passage's traced paved surface, which reaches 8.1-8.6 m right of the route line there, beyond the right lane and the hard shoulder; the passage survey finds no overswing, so it is an artefact. One structure is missing from the survey: a sign gantry spanning the southbound carriageway at km 495.283, 40 m after the flagged spot (OSM way 981689999, visible on the aerial photo).
measures: No action for the overswing at 50.414070, 11.779623 (km 495.242): keep the convoy in the right lane.

Get the clear height of the sign gantry over the southbound carriageway at 50.413748, 11.779377 (km 495.283) from Autobahn GmbH Nordbayern, or measure it in the Bavarian laser point cloud or on site; the survey does not list it.

muenster-lech-schwarzholzwinkel.note: Gentle left-hand curve of the three-lane A 9 southbound near Schwarzholzwinkel (radius about 600–1000 m). The scan finds the blade up to 0.59 m beyond the traced carriageway edge while the front axle is at km 517.453–517.460 (about 50.237997, 11.777904); against the traced paved surface it is up to 0.6 m over 6 m². The overswing is on the outside of the curve, the west verge. On the aerial photo of 22 June 2025 that verge is grass with guide posts, and the forest edge stands about 15 m from the carriageway. Nothing at the blade's height (underside at least 1.6 m) is within reach. The overswing is real but harmless.
measures: No action needed: the blade passes up to 0.6 m over the grass verge, above the 1.05 m guide posts.
On the pre-run, check that no sign, emergency telephone or other object over about 1.5 m stands on the west verge between 50.238300, 11.778000 and 50.237900, 11.777850.

muenster-lech-goessenreuth.note: The A 9 southbound passes under the B 303 (E 48) bridge at the Bad Berneck/Himmelkron junction (39), at 50.055103, 11.617967 (km 543.04). In the laser point cloud (March 2023) the deck top is 6.22 m above the A 9, so the convoy's 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.42 m deep. The scan's estimate of 4.92 ± 0.45 m is too close to call; the aerial photo of 22 June 2025 confirms the bridge. The other two structures in the passage are clear for any normal deck: the track bridge at km 542.76 (deck top 6.50 m) and Kulmbacher Straße at km 543.30 (deck top 6.63 m). This stretch of the A 9 is being rebuilt between Bad Berneck/Himmelkron and the Bayreuth/Kulmbach interchange from 1 April to the end of November 2026, with two lanes kept towards Nürnberg.
measures: Get the registered clear height of the B 303 bridge at 50.055103, 11.617967 for every southbound lane from Autobahn GmbH des Bundes, Niederlassung Nordbayern (bridge records), and route the convoy in the lane with the most clearance.

If every lane is below 4.8 m, the setup or the route must change before the permit. The junction offers no bypass: it is a partial cloverleaf, and both southbound ramps (slip road and loop, in the north-west quadrant) meet the A 9 north of the bridge.

Before fixing the date, get the roadworks traffic layout from Autobahn GmbH Nordbayern (Außenstelle Bayreuth), and ask whether and when the convoy may pass the roadworks. Until the end of November 2026 there are two narrowed lanes towards Nürnberg.

muenster-lech-oberaltenreuth.note: A 9 southbound at the Bayreuth/Kulmbach interchange (A 70). The scan finds the wheels 1.06 m and the blade 1.52 m beyond the edge, with the front axle at km 546.813–546.869 (50.022686, 11.604433 to 50.022188, 11.604319). These are a tracing artefact. On the aerial photo of 22 June 2025 the northbound carriageway has been removed for reconstruction, and traffic runs on the southbound carriageway. For about 40 m the traced right-hand edge cuts in by about 5 m along an asphalt joint, while the paved surface continues to the west. The guide post in the wheels' path is not a mapped object: the model places guide posts along the traced edge at standard spacing, and this one (km 546.824) sits on the wrong edge. The km post is OSM node 16535880 (km 296.0, at 50.022550, 11.604397), which lies on the carriageway in the photo; km posts stand behind the edge, outside the wheels' path. Against the traced paved surface the passage has no blade beyond the edge. The real check is the clear height under the BT 46 bridge over the A 9 at the Bindlacher Berg junction, at 50.014847, 11.605529 (km 547.70). In the laser point cloud (March 2023) the deck top is 6.37 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.57 m deep. The scan's second structure, 'unknown' at 50.014682, 11.605592 (km 547.72; deck top 6.42 m, estimate 5.22 ± 0.50 m), is OSM way 1409434383. OSM maps it as a BT 46 bridge under construction 20 m south of the existing one; the June 2025 photo shows no second deck there.
measures: No action for the wheels, the guide post and the km post at km 546.81–546.87: they come from the construction-phase photo and an imprecise OSM km post. On the pre-run, confirm that the southbound carriageway at 50.022450, 11.604370 is back to its normal layout and that the km post stands behind the edge.

Get the registered clear height of the BT 46 bridge at 50.014847, 11.605529 from Autobahn GmbH Nordbayern. Also ask whether a replacement bridge is being built 20 m south (OSM way 1409434383) and, if so, its clear height and construction stage on the transport date.

Get the roadworks layout for the transport date from Autobahn GmbH Nordbayern (Außenstelle Bayreuth). The 2026 works between Bad Berneck/Himmelkron and this interchange (1 April to end November 2026) include repairs to a retaining wall inside the interchange, and the connector from Bamberg towards Berlin is narrowed to one lane.

muenster-lech-neunkirchen-am-sand.note: At the Lauf/Hersbruck junction (49), the A 9 southbound passes under two railway bridges. On the aerial photo of 7 September 2025 both are steel through-truss bridges: the Nürnberg–Cheb line at 49.519018, 11.307351 (km 615.49) and the Nürnberg–Schwandorf line at 49.510659, 11.298557 (km 616.61). In the laser point cloud (January 2025) the deck tops are 6.63 m and 6.72 m above the road. With a through truss, that level is probably the track bed between the trusses. The construction depth below it (rail, sleepers, ballast, deck plate, cross girders) is not in open data, so the scan's estimates of 5.13 ± 0.60 m and 5.22 ± 0.60 m are rough. The exit to the B 14 diverges just after the Nürnberg–Cheb bridge, so it cannot be used to avoid that bridge. The other structures in the passage are clear: the primary road bridge at km 615.75 (deck top 8.15 m), the path at km 615.73 and the unclassified road at km 616.49 (deck top 6.64 m). The 2.96 m reading at km 616.18 is a vehicle in the surface model.
measures: Get the registered clear heights of both railway bridges (49.519018, 11.307351 and 49.510659, 11.298557) for every southbound lane from DB InfraGO AG or Autobahn GmbH Nordbayern. Under a through truss the lowest point is the underside of the cross girders, and it can vary across the width.
If either bridge is below 4.8 m, the A 9 cannot be used here with this setup: change the route or the root-adapter height before the permit. No detour was checked.
Pass under both bridges at walking pace, in the lane with the most clearance, with a spotter watching the root adapter's top edge.

muenster-lech-feucht.note: At the Nürnberg-Ost interchange (A 6/A 9), the A 9 southbound passes under the A 6: a wide crossing of several parallel decks (both A 6 carriageways and link roads; the scan measures three) at 49.395792, 11.199682 to 49.395508, 11.199835 (km 631.74–631.78), confirmed on the aerial photo of 13 June 2025. The scan took their heights from the 1 m laser terrain (DGM1), not from the point cloud. The deck tops are 6.86, 6.70 and 6.69 m above the A 9, so 4.8 m is clear only if the decks are less than 2.06, 1.90 and 1.89 m deep (estimates 5.36, 5.20 and 5.19 ± 0.50 m). Motorway decks of this kind can be that deep, and the terrain model is a weaker source than the point cloud, so these figures are not confirmed. At the motorway structure at km 631.54 the point cloud (December 2021) shows no deck over the convoy.
measures: Get the registered clear height of every deck of the A 6 crossing over the A 9 (around 49.395650, 11.199760) for every southbound lane from Autobahn GmbH Nordbayern, and route the convoy in the lane with the most clearance.
If any lane is below 4.8 m, a detour through the interchange ramps would be needed; their radii were not checked here.

muenster-lech-feucht-2.note: Three structures over the A 9 southbound at Feucht. The first is the Josef-Schlosser-Weg residential bridge at 49.373081, 11.200845 (km 634.30). In the laser point cloud (December 2021) its deck top is 6.11 m above the road, so 4.8 m is clear only if the deck is less than 1.31 m deep (estimate 5.11 ± 0.40 m). The other two are the ramp bridges of the A 9/A 73/B 8 junction, carrying the ramps to the B 8 (Feucht, Neumarkt) and to the A 73, at 49.365892, 11.201781 and 49.365788, 11.201796 (km 635.10–635.12). Their deck tops are 6.67 m and 6.63 m, clear if the decks are less than 1.87 m and 1.83 m deep (estimates 5.17 and 5.13 ± 0.50 m). The aerial photo of 13 June 2025 confirms all three. It also shows yellow temporary lane markings on the A 9 southbound under the ramp bridges, so there were roadworks on that date.
measures: Get the registered clear heights of the Josef-Schlosser-Weg bridge (49.373081, 11.200845) and of both ramp bridges (49.365892, 11.201781 and 49.365788, 11.201796) for every southbound lane from Autobahn GmbH Nordbayern; for Josef-Schlosser-Weg, from Markt Feucht if it owns that bridge.
Check with Autobahn GmbH Nordbayern whether roadworks under the junction ramps change the lane layout on the transport date.

muenster-lech-feldkirchen.note: Both 'street lamps in the wheels' path' are artefacts: they are wall-mounted lamps in underpasses beneath the A 9, not on it. The lamp at km 708.00 (48.779037, 11.460434) is OSM node 7154572518 (lamp_mount=wall, level=-1) in the Fort-Wrede-Straße underpass (way 39698489, tunnel, OSM maxheight 3.7 m); the scan gave it a typical 9 m height. The lamp at km 709.16 (48.768683, 11.460290) is OSM node 7157000459, one of four wall lamps (ref 07227) under the A 9 bridge over Regensburger Straße (IN 11). What matters for the transport is the roadworks. On the aerial photo of 23 May 2026, the A 9 southbound carriageway from about km 707.75 to 708.30 (48.781217, 11.460186 to 48.776288, 11.460798) is a building site, with a new bridge deck over Fort-Wrede-Straße. Traffic appears to run on the northbound carriageway, and the convoy's line in the data runs across the building site.
measures: No action for the lamps: they light the underpasses below the A 9, and the convoy passes over them.

Ask Autobahn GmbH Südbayern for the traffic layout of the roadworks at the Fort-Wrede-Straße bridge (48.779000, 11.460500) on the transport date. Get the lane widths, the crossover positions and whether an oversize convoy may pass. If the southbound carriageway is still closed, check the radii and widths of the crossovers for the 95 m convoy.

muenster-lech-neuhof.note: Two narrow farm-road overpasses cross the two-lane B 16 in Landkreis Donau-Ries, confirmed on the aerial photo of 23 May 2026: west of Staudheim at 48.709810, 10.976665 (km 756.64; OSM width 4.5 m) and at Gut Neuhof near Mittelstetten at 48.707888, 10.948768 (km 758.72). In the laser point cloud (January 2023) the deck tops are 6.04 m and 5.96 m above the road. The convoy's 4.8 m is therefore clear only if the decks are less than 1.24 m and 1.16 m deep (estimates 5.04 ± 0.40 m and 4.96 ± 0.40 m). Both are tight, and the registered heights decide the passage.
measures: Before the permit, get the registered clear heights of both overpasses (48.709810, 10.976665 and 48.707888, 10.948768) from the Staatliches Bauamt Augsburg, which is responsible for the B 16 in Landkreis Donau-Ries, or measure them on site across the convoy's lane and the centre line.
If either is under 4.8 m, the passage is blocked for the planned setup: lower the root adapter or front unit if the shortfall is small, or plan a detour off the B 16 (none was checked here).
Pass under both at walking pace in the position with the most measured clearance, with oncoming traffic held.
